title: claude -p in a freshly cloned repo runs its hooks and .mcp.json servers without asking
symptoms: Hook commands from the repo's .claude/settings.json run in CI
MCP servers from .mcp.json start with no approval prompt in a folder never trusted
cause: Print mode shows no workspace trust dialog and no per-server approval prompt, so a project's hooks and MCP servers run even in a folder that was never trusted.
fix: On untrusted code or in CI use --bare, which skips hooks, MCP servers, plugins, skills, auto memory, and CLAUDE.md, and pass what the run needs with flags.
affected: Claude Code print mode, as of 2026-10
